description: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different stimulus types used in the study, with each segment corresponding to a specific category and its percentage share. The chart is divided into eight distinct slices, each labeled with its category name and percentage value. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, shown in a dark red color. Following this are “Press Release” at 18.7% (yellow), “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green), “Interview” at 8.8% (purple), “Organizational Report” at 7.7% (light purple), “Event Posting” at 6.6% (dark brown), “Intra-agency news article” at 4.9% (blue), and “Organizational Website” at 4.9% (dark blue). The smallest segment is “Social Media Post” at 1.1% (light orange). Each category is clearly labeled with its percentage outside the ring, and the chart includes a central white space with the title. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending in size from the largest to the smallest, though not perfectly sorted. There is no legend, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded.
